verdict.rationale: Name.com is a hosted domain registrar and DNS service. Self-hosting is a fair openness question for a software service, but the evidence pack never documents a self-hostable or downloadable deployment of the core product. The sandbox testing environment is a vendor-hosted test API, not self-hosting, and the MCP server and SDKs are client-side integration tools, so neither counts toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
